In line with this commitment and in compliance with South African gambling laws, we have established a Self Exclusion Policy to assist any of customers who may need to limit or cease their gambling activities.</p><h2>What is Self Exclusion?</h2><p>We believe that gambling should always be an enjoyable activity and our customers should have fun from it. The majority enjoy the entertainment and gambling services we provide, but for some, gambling may stop being a harmless leisure activity and become a problem. SportyBet provides voluntary self exclusion in which its customers may prohibit themselves from partaking in gambling.</p><p>During the customers’ selected self exclusion periods, they will be restricted from depositing, betting or playing games. They may still login to their accounts to withdraw funds. As per SportyBet’s risk management procedures, a balance will not be withdrawable if it has not been previously staked.</p><p>A self exclusion period may be selected by the customer, but it may be for no less than 6 months.</p><h2>How to Apply for Self Exclusion?</h2><p>Customers must lodge their self exclusion requests through completion of the Self Exclusion Form and sending by email to <a href=\"mailto:selfexclusion@sporty.com\">selfexclusion@sporty.com</a>.</p><h2>Managing Self Exclusions</h2><p>Once a Self Exclusion application has been received by our customer, the following measures are in place to ensure compliance with the customer’s stated self exclusion request.</p><p>We shall immediately notify the Mpumalanga Economic Regulator and furnish them with the customer’s self exclusion application. Additionally we should notify any of our affiliates offering gambling activities within the region where the self exclusion may apply.</p><p>During self exclusion periods, customers will be removed from all marketing lists and consequently will not receive any communications from us, which will include, but not be limited to, promotional SMSes, emails, and phone calls.</p><p>Self excluded customers may not apply to open other accounts, and their accounts may be permanently suspended should they not abide by our Self Exclusion Policy.</p><p>A person can be excluded from participating in any form of gambling by the courts or various provincial gambling regulators. Upon receiving the appropriate instructions from the regulators, SportyBet will add the individual to its list of excluded persons. The excluded individual will not be permitted to register or place bets on the SportyBet Website, until such time as SportyBet is notified by a South African gambling regulator that the individual may be removed from the exclusion list.</p><h2>Notice of Exclusion</h2><p>When customers submit their self exclusion applications to us, they will be sent a written Notices of Exclusion. These will provide customers with information of their obligations regarding voluntary self exclusion and the support available to them. This will include, at a minimum:</p><p>(1) A caution that they are restricted from depositing, betting or playing games. Should they be able to place any bets during their self exclusion period, they shall not be entitled to these winnings.</p><p>(2) At no stage will this self exclusion period be removed or reduced and a customers’ accounts may be permanently suspended if they do not abide by our Self Exclusion Policy.</p><p>(3) SportyBet is committed to Responsible Gambling and we encourage our customers to refer to our Responsible Gaming Policy which includes support, resources and advice to ensure they limit their spending and stay in control. This includes seeking support from professional gambling counselling services, which we highly recommend. The following resources are available for free:</p><p>National Responsible Gambling Foundation: 0800 006 008 (toll free 24 hour helpline)<br>National Responsible Gambling Programme (NRGP): <a rel=\"noopener\">www.responsiblegambling.org.za</a></p><p>(4) Following the end of our customers’ self exclusion periods, we will require them to submit evidence that they have received assistance and/or advice regarding responsible gambling.</p><h2>Confidentiality and Privacy</h2><p>All self-exclusion requests and related communications will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Customer information will only be shared with relevant parties as necessary to enforce the self exclusion and in compliance with South African data protection laws.</p><p>We shall notify the Mpumalanga Economic Regulator immediately and furnish them with our customers’ self exclusion application. Additionally, we will share information on all self-exclusions and related activities on at least a monthly basis, which shall include, at a minimum:</p><p>(1) a list of self exclusion applications and the reason thereof,<br>(2) whether any self exclusions were uplifted,<br>(3) the extent of any winnings that were received by self excluded individuals,<br>(4) whether there were any violations of our Policy, and<br>(5) related statistics.<br> </p><p>Documents regarding self exclusions will be made available to the Mpumalanga Gambling Board during their inspections, and at their request.</p><h2>Compliance with South African Gambling Laws</h2><p>The Mpumalanga Economic Regulator and SportyBet takes its Self Exclusion obligations very seriously. Our policy is in compliance with the National Gambling Act, 2004 (Act No. 7 of 2004), Mpumalanga Gambling Rules, and other relevant South African regulations. We will cooperate with the National Gambling Board, the Mpumalanga Economic Regulator, and other regulatory authorities to ensure adherence to responsible gambling practices.</p><h2>Authority to Process Self Exclusions</h2><p>Only senior members of the Operational and Support teams may be permitted to process and authorise self exclusion requests.</p><h2>Acknowledgement</h2><p>By submitting a Self Exclusion Request, you confirm that you have read and understood this Self Exclusion Policy. You also confirm that you have voluntarily acted in your own capacity, with sound mind and understand the implications for you of this self exclusion. Furthermore, you confirm that your self exclusion and related information may be shared by us with relevant parties as necessary to enforce the self exclusion or fulfil any legal obligation.</p>","type":"HTML"},"self_exclusion_title":{"key":"self_exclusion_title","value":"Self-Exclusion","type":"TEXT"},"intro_2_1_app":{"key":"intro_2_1_app","value":"Users who opt for self-exclusion are prohibited from creating new Sporty accounts during the self-exclusion period.","type":"TEXT"},"intro_2_2_app":{"key":"intro_2_2_app","value":"Once you self exclude your account, it cannot be re-enabled until the time period has concluded or by contacting customer service.","type":"TEXT"},"time_out":{"key":"time_out","value":"Time Out","type":"TEXT"},"month":{"key":"month","value":"Month","type":"TEXT"},"months":{"key":"months","value":"Months","type":"TEXT"},"year":{"key":"year","value":"Year","type":"TEXT"},"years":{"key":"years","value":"Years","type":"TEXT"},"permanent_exclusion":{"key":"permanent_exclusion","value":"Permanent Exclusion","type":"TEXT"},"ops_exclusion_title":{"key":"ops_exclusion_title","value":"Account Exclusion Now","type":"TEXT"},"ops_exclusion_body":{"key":"ops_exclusion_body","value":"You can only withdraw the available balance from this SportyBet account.
